Native callback validity and physical display are outside this theorem; runtime controls separately reject staging-only, wrong ticket, and shifted completion.

Ownership/body/lifetime validation and native callback progress remain separate caller/native boundaries.

Applying the running transition law preserves that prior candidate and does not release the obligation.

The certificate applies the runtime transition soundness theorem to that success, proving a prior receipt or an accepted matching fresh candidate was required.
